FINDINGS.finding: the universal reader targets the wrong quantity. The planted effect is a band that is SYMMETRIC about pseudotime 0.5, so a linear reader cannot recover t from it.
FINDINGS.consequence: reporting pseudotime R2 would call a well-recovered component unrecoverable
FINDINGS.required: target the band, prospectively defined, not pseudotime

FINDINGS.finding: the effect is multiplicative, so it lives in module_score / drive, not in any linear combination of module scores
FINDINGS.required: explicit ratio contrast as a prospectively declared sufficient statistic

FINDINGS.finding: not a module quantity at all; its sufficient statistic is depth/support, which the module-score design matrix does not contain
FINDINGS.required: library size and support count as explicit features

FINDINGS.finding: a single R2 is not the estimand; the estimand is the full-versus-additive GAP
FINDINGS.note: the gap now EXCEEDS the 0.05 designed threshold at full scale, where it was 0.015 at 96 features

FINDINGS.finding: region-to-gene precision/recall against the planted graph is a different evaluation entirely and is not expressible as a module score
the design matrix is built FROM module_address_sets, i.e. from truth. A real model must DISCOVER modules. So this measures recoverability GIVEN PERFECT MODULE DISCOVERY.
FINDINGS.required: label every ceiling as an upper bound under known support, never as a blind achievable ceiling

FINDINGS.finding: pathway-redundancy families make module scores collinear by design
FINDINGS.note: tolerable at p=37 and n=2000; component-specific statistics avoid it entirely
